Lungren Believes People Dying Of Alcoholism Should Be Able To Smoke Tobacco in Bars
But Not Marijuana in Hospices

(Ed. note: Some things we just could not make up. A man who wants to arrest the sick and dying for using medical marijuana , would allow people to drink themselves to death and smoke tobacco while they do it. His tolerance – as far as it goes --is admirable, but his inconsistency is morally and intellectually disgusting. Thanks to Eric Skidmore for this gem.)

Excerpted from an article in the San Francisco Chronicle

March 26, 1998

chronletters@sfgate.com

Excerpted from an article in the San Francisco Chronicle

March 26, 1998

By Greg Lucas, Chronicle Sacramento Bureau

Attorney General Dan Lungren, a GOP candidate for governor, …. said if he were governor he would sign a bill to allow smoking to resume in the state’s roughly 37,300 bars or bar-restaurants.

"I think there ought to be some leeway on bars," Lungren told reporters yesterday…. "What are we going to do with some of these folks—stamp big T’s on their foreheads, the new scarlet letter?

"I would sign a bill that would allow some flexibility so that you could smoke in bars. That’s controversial, what the hell. While they’re drinking themselves to death, let them have a cigarette. With the death penalty you used to allow someone one last smoke."
